Producer style: 80s British Heavy Metal. Roles: guitar: Soaring lead solos and heavy rhythm chugs; bass: Punchy, driving bass lines locking with drums; drums: Powerful gallop rhythm, double bass and crash cymbals; vocals: Raspy, high-pitched lead vocals with heavy reverb. inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Wheels of steel on the midnight road
Chasing shadows, bearing the load
The engine roars a thunderous call
Answering the darkness, standing tall

[Pre-Chorus]
Rising up from the dust and fire
With a burning, hungry desire

[Chorus]
Steel horizon, breaking the dawn
We ride the wind, we carry on
Steel horizon, wild and free
Underneath the endless sea

[Verse]
Swords of light in the morning sky
Cutting through the clouds so high
No fear remains in the warrior's heart
Only the beat of the drum apart

[Pre-Chorus]
Rising up from the dust and fire
With a burning, hungry desire

[Chorus]
Steel horizon, breaking the dawn
We ride the wind, we carry on
Steel horizon, wild and free
Underneath the endless sea

[Bridge]
Guitar Solo

[Chorus]
Steel horizon, breaking the dawn
We ride the wind, we carry on
Steel horizon, wild and free
Underneath the endless sea

[Outro]
Steel horizon... fading light... gone.
